Check [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/H3xas/devscout-rs/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) first —
your idea may already be planned, in which case a comment there (or on a linked issue) is
more useful than a duplicate.

## Problem

What are you trying to do that devscout doesn't currently support? Prefer describing the
underlying problem over a specific implementation.

## Proposed solution

A sketch of the command, flag, or output shape you have in mind, if you have one.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you've worked around this, or other tools you've compared against.

## Additional context

Anything else — example repositories, related issues, etc.
